meta.name: trigger-finder
meta.description: Buying trigger analysis skill for outbound sales teams. Identifies and interprets trigger events (funding, hiring, tool changes, job changes, LinkedIn activity, M&A, etc.) to help time outreach and sharpen messaging. Works in two modes: (1) Strategic — given an ICP, recommends the best triggers to activate and the right messaging angle for each; (2) Tactical — given a specific company or signal, explains how to exploit it right now. ALWAYS use this skill when the user mentions signals, triggers, buying intent, "right time to reach out", timing outreach, "they just raised", "they just hired", "they changed jobs", job postings, funding rounds, tech stack changes, LinkedIn activity, or any event-based prospecting. Use it even if the user just says "when should I reach out to X".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 识别买家触发事件，优化外呼时机与话术
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做B2B外呼销售，需要根据客户事件精准把握联系时机。
copy.tagline_en: Identify buyer trigger events to time outreach and sharpen messaging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do B2B outbound sales and need to time outreach based on customer events.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude会分析触发事件（如融资、招聘、工具变更等）来判断最佳联系时机和消息角度。战略模式：根据目标客户画像推荐最佳触发器和对应消息；战术模式：针对特定公司或信号解释如何立即利用。
howto.when: 当用户提及信号、触发器、购买意向、最佳联系时机、融资、招聘、职位变动、LinkedIn活动等，或直接问“何时联系X”时触发。

say.text: 我们卖HR软件，应该关注哪些触发信号？
say.note: 进入战略模式，Claude会询问ICP并生成触发手册。

say.text: 这家公司刚融资，怎么联系？
say.note: 进入战术模式，Claude会分析该信号并给出行动建议。

say.text: 我的目标客户是B轮SaaS的VP销售，制定触发策略。
say.note: Claude会询问产品详情并输出触发手册。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes trigger events (funding, hiring, tool changes, etc.) to determine the best timing and messaging angle. In Strategic mode, it recommends triggers for an ICP; in Tactical mode, it explains how to exploit a specific signal for a company.
howto.when_en: Triggers when users mention signals, triggers, buying intent, 'right time to reach out', funding, hiring, job changes, LinkedIn activity, or when they ask 'when should I reach out to X'.

say_en.text: We sell HR software; which triggers should we watch?
say_en.note: Enters Strategic mode. Claude asks for ICP and generates a trigger playbook.

say_en.text: This company just raised funding, how to reach out?
say_en.note: Enters Tactical mode. Claude analyzes the signal and suggests actions.

say_en.text: My ICP is VP Sales at B2B SaaS Series B, build a trigger strategy.
say_en.note: Claude asks for product details and outputs a trigger playbook.
